Catalogue.title: Rent a bike
Catalogue.subtitle: Pick a bike and collect it at the nearest station.
Catalogue.emptyDescription: Start the database (pnpm db:up), apply migrations (pnpm db:migrate) and load sample data (pnpm db:seed).

BikeDescriptions.gravel: A fast, forgiving gravel bike for mixed surfaces — wide tyres, relaxed geometry and mounts for everything you need on a long day out.
BikeDescriptions.mtb: A hardtail mountain bike built for trails and singletrack: air fork, hydraulic disc brakes and grippy 29" tyres.
BikeDescriptions.urban: A women's step-through city bike with an upright riding position, fenders and a rack — perfect for commuting and relaxed rides.
